backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles with access control, create/update logic, and load recommendation defaults based on experience level.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented frontend files to product requirements and diagnostic improvements.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of key frontend pages, routing files, and utilities used for build planning.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base/theme definitions configuring light and dark mode color variables and global styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app root and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main router configuration with auth/profile guards, startup loading screen, error fallback, and all app routes.
frontend/src/components/builder/Exercise: Searchable modal dialog listing mock exercises and allowing the user to select one.
frontend/src/components/exercises/Exerci: UI card displaying exercise title, tags, and brief coaching cue, clickable for navigation.
frontend/src/components/exercises/LoadRe: Card computing dynamic load recommendations, showing safety zones, and allowing manual load adjustment via slider.
frontend/src/components/exercises/MediaP: Displays a placeholder box with an image or video icon and label.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Wraps the app with header, main content container, and bottom tabs.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Shows a top navigation bar with back button or logo and logout handling.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Botto: Renders bottom navigation tabs with icons and active state highlighting.
frontend/src/components/refresh/PullToRe: Implements pull‑to‑refresh behavior with touch handling and a loading indicator.
frontend/src/components/routing/AppLoadi: Displays a full‑screen loading spinner and startup message.
frontend/src/components/routing/RouteErr: Shows an error screen with reload option and special messaging for startup/auth failures.
frontend/src/components/subscription/Pro: Gates content behind a Pro subscription and shows an upgrade prompt if locked.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor based on identity and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdmin.ts: Provides hooks for fetching all users and updating subscription tiers via the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUser.ts: Provides hooks for fetching, creating, updating, and deleting the caller's profile and checking admin status.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity auth client, login state, and stored identity lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubscription.ts: Provides a mutation hook for upgrading the user to a Pro tier.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind variables, base styles, and interaction behaviors.
frontend/src/lib/dynamicLoad.ts: Calculates recommended dynamic load ranges based on bodyweight, experience, and config multipliers.
frontend/src/lib/exercises.ts: Defines the Exercise interface and provides mock exercise data with load multipliers and guidance.
frontend/src/lib/gravityAI/knowledge.ts: Implements AI response generators for load, plans, recovery, technique, and product education based on user profile.
frontend/src/lib/gravityAI/respond.ts: Routes user messages to the appropriate AI response function using keyword detection.
frontend/src/lib/loadAlgorithms.ts: Calculates base percentages and recommended vest load ranges from bodyweight and experience level.
frontend/src/lib/loadZones.ts: Provides load zone classification and corresponding status text and colors.
frontend/src/lib/routerAuthStore.ts: Manages global auth state and provides a resolver for router guards to await deterministic auth/profile completion.
frontend/src/lib/workoutMetrics.ts: Calculates workout volume and an intensity score from exercise sets, reps, and load.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with query client and identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelPage.tsx: Renders an admin dashboard for viewing users and updating subscription tiers with navigation and UI controls.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Displays user performance metrics with mock data and supports pull‑to‑refresh via profile refetching.
frontend/src/pages/ExerciseDetailPage.ts: Shows detailed exercise info, media placeholders, and personalized load recommendations based on user profile.
frontend/src/pages/ExercisesPage.tsx: Provides an exercise catalog with sport and difficulty filters and navigation to individual exercise pages.
frontend/src/pages/GravityAIPage.tsx: Implements a chat interface for GravityAI with message history, suggestions, and AI‑generated responses.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Handles Internet Identity login flow and displays loading or sign‑in UI depending on auth state.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx: Renders a 404 page with navigation logic that redirects based on authentication status.
frontend/src/pages/OnboardingPage.tsx: Guides new users through multi‑step profile setup, collecting physical data and preferences before creating a profile.
frontend/src/pages/PlanDetailPage.tsx: Displays a mock training plan with weekly details and an RPE feedback prompt.
frontend/src/pages/PlansPage.tsx: Renders a gated list of HYROX training plans with Pro-only access control and navigation to plan details or upgrade.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Provides profile management including editing user attributes, subscription display, and account deletion.
frontend/src/pages/UpgradePage.tsx: Displays Pro subscription options, handles upgrade flow, and prevents access if user is already Pro.
frontend/src/pages/WorkoutBuilderPage.ts: Allows building custom workouts with exercises, calculates session metrics, and saves workout templates.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters and sessionStorage-backed values.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme colors, typography, container settings, and plugin setup.
project_state.json: Stores the current project state, including app summary, architectural notes, known issues, and a list of implemented features. Used as a reference for build planning and tracking required fixes.
